# fastf 3.1.2 — the terminal fastf opens is yours

A fix release. The tool is otherwise unchanged from 3.1.1.

## The relaunch marker stays inside fastf

Started from a desktop launcher, fastf has nowhere to write, so it re-runs
itself in a terminal window and marks that run with an internal variable —
`FASTF_RELAUNCHED` — which is what stops the rerun relaunching again.

That variable is inherited. A window opened from the guided app, or by `fastf
term`, handed it to the shell in that window, and that shell handed it to
everything typed into it for as long as the window lived. Two consequences, both
invisible: inside such a window fastf never opened a terminal for itself again,
and any other program that reads the variable saw it too — including fastf's own
test suite, so building the AUR source package from one of those windows failed.

`fastf term` and the app's terminal action now clear it before handing the
window over. Nothing fastf gives you carries fastf's bookkeeping.

## Upgrading

Install 3.1.2 and there is nothing else to do. A terminal window that an older
fastf opened keeps the variable until you close it.
